diff --git a/throttle/limiter.py b/throttle/limiter.py
index 2576114..0c94de6 100644
--- a/throttle/limiter.py
+++ b/throttle/limiter.py
@@ -19,6 +19,8 @@ class Limiter:
         """Record one hit for ``key``; True when the hit is allowed."""
         count = self._counts.get(key, 0) + 1
         self._counts[key] = count
-        if count > self.threshold:
+        if count > self.threshold and key not in self._blocked:
+            if self.on_limit is not None:
+                self.on_limit(key)
             self._blocked.add(key)
         return count <= self.threshold
